subject.title: fix(plugins): false-positive duplicate plugin ID warning on gateway start (msteams)

question: Should distinct-root cross-origin plugin id shadows be silent like same-physical-root rediscovery, or should OpenClaw keep the documented warning for config-selected duplicate overrides?
rationale: Current main already fixes same-physical-root false positives, while changing distinct-root config override warnings would alter documented startup diagnostics and an existing shipped installed-override behavior.

options.title: Keep Documented Warning Policy
options.body: Keep same-physical-root and explicit installed overrides quiet, but continue warning for distinct-root config-selected shadows unless a maintainer intentionally changes the docs/tests.

options.title: Change To Cross-Origin Silence
options.body: Refresh the linked PR so distinct-root cross-origin shadows are silent while preserving installed-over-bundled silence and updating docs/tests to match.

options.title: Require Live msteams Proof First
options.body: Ask for a live gateway startup reproduction before deciding whether the remaining warning is false positive or useful operator diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Keep Documented Warning Policy
recommendation.body: Keep same-physical-root and explicit installed overrides quiet, but continue warning for distinct-root config-selected shadows unless a maintainer intentionally changes the docs/tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the open linked replacement PR and is best positioned to accept, narrow, or retire that implementation path.
